summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing agreements to sell six vessels for an aggregate of $300 million, comprising three LR2 product tankers for $195 million and three MR product tankers for $105 million. The vessels sold are 2014-built; no purchase price per share or premium is applicable as this is an asset sale. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor is named. Outstanding debt on some vessels totals approximately $32 million against a revolving credit facility. Closings expected within Q2 2026. Watch for completion timing and use of proceeds.
